# A fast thrown rock hurts the enemy nearest to it, not the one it touched (851-3383, docs/quirks.md §1): the
# wiki clip quirks/thrown-item-nearest-enemy's scene (wiki-clips --replays), a custom level loaded from the
# title's load-level menu (240) with a spider (x 224) and a bat (x 240) hanging side by side from the ceiling.
# The player picks up a rock (duck + X, 283) and throws it up while walking right (up + X, 303). On 309 the
# rock, at (234, 56), touches the spider's box (x 224-239, y 48-57) and not the bat's (x 243-253), but
# oItem's step hurts instance_nearest(x, y, oEnemy), and the bat's position (240, 48) is nearer the rock's
# than the spider's (224, 48): the bat's hp goes to 0 and it dies on 310, while the spider keeps hanging.
# (Played without the bat, the spider dies on 309; without the spider, the bat lives until the rock reaches
# it on 310.) The player stands still from 313.
# story: customLevelName=WIKI@240 held=oRock@283 held!=oRock@303 oBat.hp=0@309 -oBat@310 bats=1@310
# story: !-oSpiderHang !+oSpider !oSpiderHang.hp<1
